environment.description: Same CLI tool compiled identically, same nginx proxy_pass architecture. However, the nginx location block serving this tool's output includes: add_header Content-Security-Policy "script-src 'nonce-$request_id'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'" always; — where $request_id is a per-request cryptographic nonce generated by ngx_http_request_id_module. Additionally, the binary is compiled with -fsanitize=address linked statically, and the process runs under a seccomp-bpf profile (via systemd SeccompFilter=) that restricts syscalls to read/write/open/close/fstat/mmap/brk/exit_group/futex only — preventing execve and mprotect, which blocks shellcode execution even if the double-free achieves arbitrary write. The ASAN instrumentation causes immediate abort() on double-free detection before any output is written to stdout.

config.seccomp_profile: allow: read write open openat close fstat mmap brk exit_group futex rt_sigaction; deny: execve mprotect clone fork
